# Noregstoget

> A schematic, tube-map-style live map of the Norwegian passenger rail network.

Live URL: https://togkartet.msge.no
Language: Norwegian Nynorsk (interface) / bilingual descriptions
License: MIT
Source: https://github.com/mmsge/togkartet

## What it does

- Displays real-time train positions on a schematic railway map of Norway
- Updates every 15 seconds using Entur's public GTFS-RT and SIRI-VM feeds
- Covers 26 Norwegian passenger rail lines and approximately 280 stations
- Click any train: see its route, operator, scheduled stops, and current delay
- Click any station: see a live departure/arrival board
- Dark mode support; works in any modern browser; no login required

## Lines covered

| Line | Route | Operator |
|------|-------|----------|
| Bergensbanen | Bergen – Oslo S | Vy |
| Flåmsbana | Myrdal – Flåm | Vy |
| Sørlandsbanen | Stavanger – Oslo S | Go Ahead Nordic |
| Raumabanen | Åndalsnes – Dombås | SJ Nord |
| Arendalsbanen | Nelaug – Arendal | Go Ahead Nordic |
| Dovrebanen | Trondheim S – Oslo S | SJ Nord / Vy |
| Rørosbanen | Støren – Hamar (via Røros) | SJ Nord |
| Nordlandsbanen | Bodø – Trondheim S | SJ Nord |
| Ofotbanen | Narvik – Swedish border | SJ |
| Meråkerbanen | Trondheim S – Swedish border | SJ Nord |
| Kongsvingerbanen | Oslo S – Swedish border (Kongsvinger) | Vy |
| Østfoldbanen | Oslo S – Swedish border (Halden) | Vy |
| Gjøvikbanen | Oslo S – Gjøvik | Gjøvikbanen AS |
| Gardermobanen | Oslo S – Oslo Lufthavn | Vy |
| Jærbanen | Stavanger – Egersund | Go Ahead Nordic |
| Vestfoldbanen | Oslo S – Skien | Go Ahead Nordic |
| Bratsbergbanen | Notodden – Skien | Go Ahead Nordic |
| Randsfjordbanen | Oslo S – Hønefoss / Fagernes | Vy |

## Operators

- **Vy** (codespace: VYG) — largest operator; Bergensbanen, Østfoldbanen, Kongsvingerbanen, Gardermobanen, commuter lines
- **SJ Nord** (codespace: SJN) — Nordlandsbanen, Dovrebanen, Rørosbanen, Raumabanen, Meråkerbanen, Trønderbanen
- **SJ Sverige** (codespace: SJV) — Ofotbanen (Stockholm–Narvik night train)
- **Go Ahead Nordic** (codespace: GOA) — Sørlandsbanen, Arendalsbanen, Vestfoldbanen, Jærbanen
- **Gjøvikbanen AS** (codespace: GJB) — Oslo–Gjøvik commuter service
- **FlixTrain** (codespace: FLT) — budget intercity

## Data sources

All APIs are provided by Entur (Norwegian public transport authority). No API key required.

- GTFS-RT vehicle positions: `https://api.entur.io/realtime/v1/gtfs-rt/vehicle-positions`
- SIRI-VM fallback: `https://api.entur.io/realtime/v1/rest/vm`
- Journey Planner (routes, stop times, delays): `https://api.entur.io/journey-planner/v3/graphql`

## Update cadence

Train positions refresh every 15 seconds. Station departure boards are fetched on demand when a station is clicked (90-second client-side cache).

## Technology

Vanilla JavaScript SPA — no build system, no npm dependencies at runtime. Leaflet.js (CDN) for map rendering. Protocol Buffers (protobuf.js, CDN) for GTFS-RT decoding. Network topology stored in `data/network.json` (schematic coordinates). Deployed on GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions from the `hovud` branch.

## For more detail

See `/llms-full.txt` for the complete technical reference including the network JSON schema, real-time data pipeline, key NSR stop IDs, and known limitations.
